mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settle_file ( file_no, task_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, file_name, file_size, file_md5, storage_bucket, storage_path, version, status ) VALUES ( #{fileNo}, #{taskNo}, #{settleDate}, #{memberId}, #{fileType}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{fileMd5}, #{storageBucket}, #{storagePath}, #{version}, #{status} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_no = VALUES(file_no), task_no = VALUES(task_no), file_name = VALUES(file_name), file_size = VALUES(file_size), file_md5 = VALUES(file_md5), storage_bucket = VALUES(storage_bucket), storage_path = VALUES(storage_path), status = VALUES(status)
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_no, task_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, file_name, file_size, file_md5, storage_bucket, storage_path, version, status, publish_time, download_count, created_at, updated_at FROM settle_file WHERE file_no = #{fileNo}

SELECT id, file_no, task_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, file_name, file_size, file_md5, storage_bucket, storage_path, version, status, publish_time, download_count, created_at, updated_at FROM settle_file WHERE settle_date = #{settleDate} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND file_type = #{fileType} AND version = #{version}
